text:
A !!{formula}~$!A(x_1, \dots, x_k)$ \emph{!!{represents}} the
relation $R \subseteq \Nat^k$ iff,
\begin{enumerate}
\item whenever $R(n_1, \dots, n_k)$, $\Gamma \Proves !A(\num{n_1},
\dots, \num{n_k})$, and
\item whenever not $R(n_1, \dots, n_k)$, $\Gamma \Proves \lnot
!A(\num{n_1}, \dots, \num{n_k})$.
\end{enumerate}
